summary.prose: A Story's code review, its diff-only review and its BUILD records now decide the Story's files from the Story's own commits, the ones carrying its Insrc-Story trailer since its range base. An uncommitted change joins only when it edits a file those commits already changed; every other uncommitted change is left out and listed as excluded on the review record. With no range base to anchor on, the review declines instead of reviewing whatever the working tree holds. The build gate's typecheck project selection follows the same Story set.

hldContextSlice.frameworkSummary: Standalone feature — no parent HLD. Design directly against the repo, grounded on the s1 analyze passes. There are no HLD shared contracts to honour.

boundary.internal: Scope a Story's code review to what the Story changed, never a blind working-tree diff

api.name: changedFiles
api.signature: changedFiles(repoPath: string, opts?: ChangedFilesOptions): Promise<readonly string[]>

parameters.name: opts
parameters.purpose: base (the Story's range base), storyKey (<epicHash>/<storyId>), exclude, excludeGlobs, onAttribution. With a base the Story's set is anchored on its commits; without one, today's working-tree derivation for callers that do not know a Story.

returns.meaning: With a base: the Story's set = the paths of its units (storyChangeSet with storyKey: trailer units, else every first-parent commit restricted to the Story's own paths), plus each working-tree path (unstaged or staged) that is already in that set; minus exclude. Every other working-tree path is reported, never returned. Without a base: unchanged (the working-tree derivation), for callers outside a Story.

errors.condition: git fails on the anchored derivation (as today).

preconditions: A base, when given, is a commit the repository can resolve (resolveStoryRangeBase).
postconditions: With a base, the result never contains a working-tree path outside the Story's committed set, whatever the working tree holds.
The order no longer depends on whether the tree is dirty: the Story's units are always read first.
onAttribution reports attribution ('story-trailer' | 'first-parent-range'), sharedWithExcluded and excludedUncommitted (the working-tree paths left out, sorted).

api.name: resolveCodeReviewSubject
api.signature: resolveCodeReviewSubject(repoPath: string, epicHash: string, storyId: string, deps?: SubjectDeps): Promise<CodeReviewSubjectResult>

returns.meaning: The subject's changedFiles is the anchored set (base + storyKey + ledger exclusion); it carries changeSetAttribution, sharedWithExcluded and excludedFromScope (the working-tree paths left out).

errors.condition: No range base resolves for the Story, or git fails on the anchored derivation: the review declines; the two working-tree fallbacks are removed, so a failure never turns into a review of the working tree.

preconditions: The Story's build commits carry its Insrc-Story trailer (the tracked build's commit rule).
postconditions: changeSetAttribution is never 'working-tree' on a resolved subject.
The module header states the rule: the Story's commits decide its scope; the working tree only adds edits of its own files.

api.name: assembleDiffCodeReviewGrounding
api.signature: assembleDiffCodeReviewGrounding(repoPath: string, deps?: DiffGroundingDeps, opts?: DiffGroundingOptions): Promise<DiffGroundingResult>

parameters.name: opts
parameters.purpose: base, excludeGlobs, storyKey, as the daemon RPC's degraded path and the controller step's diff-only path pass them.

returns.meaning: Per-file pseudo-symbols with hunks for the Story's set: its units' hunks, plus the working-tree hunks of files already in that set; changedFiles, changeSetAttribution, sharedWithExcluded and excludedFromScope.

errors.condition: No base was given, or git fails on the anchored derivation: the diff-only review is unavailable; the working-tree-first step and the last-commit step are removed.

preconditions: Callers pass the Story's base and storyKey (both callers already do).
postconditions: The diff-only review never grounds on a working-tree hunk of a file outside the Story's committed set, nor on another Story's last commit.

api.name: collectBuildChangeLog
api.signature: collectBuildChangeLog(repoPath: string, ctx: { author: string; timestamp: string; version?: string; base?: string; exclude?: readonly string[]; storyKey?: string }, listChanged?: (repoPath: string, opts?: ChangedFilesOptions) => Promise<readonly string[]>): Promise<ChangeLog>

parameters.name: ctx.storyKey
parameters.purpose: <epicHash>/<storyId>, forwarded so the BUILD record's changeLog follows the same anchored rule (trailer units).

returns.meaning: The BUILD record's file-level changeLog of the Story's set; unchanged swallow of a git failure to [].

postconditions: The completion record and the validate phase pass the Story's storyKey, so an unrelated uncommitted file never enters a BUILD record's changeLog.

dataModelChanges.details: excludedUncommitted: readonly string[] — the working-tree paths the anchored derivation left out because no Story commit touched them (sorted). Empty when none.
excludedFromScope?: readonly string[] — the uncommitted paths left out of this review; absent when none, so a clean tree's subject is unchanged.

excludedFromScope?: readonly string[] stamped on the review record next to changedFiles, changeSetAttribution and sharedWithExcluded, so a reader sees what was left out and why; absent when none (existing records stay valid).
A resolved subject's attribution is 'story-trailer' or 'first-parent-range'; 'working-tree' stays in the type for records written before this fix but is never produced for a Story's review.

errorCases.scenario: No range base resolves for the Story (no BUILD start stamp, no resolvable commit).
errorCases.detection: resolveStoryRangeBase returns undefined in resolveCodeReviewSubject (and the diff-only callers pass no base).
errorCases.response: The review declines with today's reason 'no-build-record' (the diff-only path raises DiffUnavailableError); nothing is reviewed and no record is written. It never falls back to the working tree.
errorCases.userImpact: The reviewer is told the Story has no anchored change set, instead of receiving a review of someone else's edits.

errorCases.scenario: git fails on the anchored derivation (rev-list, trailer scan or a unit's diff).
errorCases.detection: storyChangeSet or collectDiff throws NoBuildChangesError (DiffUnavailableError on the diff-only path).
errorCases.response: The subject declines with 'no-build-record' (the diff-only review is unavailable); the step-down to a plain working-tree derivation is removed. A BUILD changeLog still swallows the failure to [] as today.
errorCases.userImpact: A broken git state ends the review clearly rather than silently reviewing the tree.

errorCases.scenario: The working tree holds uncommitted changes outside the Story's committed set (another person's work, another Story's in-progress edits).
errorCases.detection: The working-tree diff is read after the Story's units; each path not in the Story's set is set aside.
errorCases.response: Left out of changedFiles and the grounding; reported on the subject and the review record as excludedFromScope (sorted); logged once per review with the count.
errorCases.userImpact: The review judges only the Story; the reader sees exactly which uncommitted files were left out.

edgeCases.input: An uncommitted edit to a file the Story's commits already changed.
edgeCases.expected: Included: the file stays in changedFiles and its working-tree hunks join the diff-only grounding; it is not reported as excluded.

edgeCases.input: A Story whose work is all uncommitted (no commit carries its trailer yet).
edgeCases.expected: Its committed set is empty, so every working-tree path is excluded and reported; the subject resolves with an empty changedFiles, which today's review already treats as nothing to judge.
Exactly today's committed-range result (attribution 'story-trailer' or 'first-parent-range'); excludedFromScope is absent, so the record is unchanged.

edgeCases.input: No commit carries the Story's trailer, but the range has the Story's first-parent commits (an older Story built before the trailer).
edgeCases.expected: Today's 'first-parent-range' set; working-tree paths outside it excluded as above.

edgeCases.input: An uncommitted change only to the workflow's own ledger files (.insrc/artifacts/*.json, docs/epics/**, docs/standalone/**).
edgeCases.expected: Left out by the ledger exclusion before attribution, as today; not reported as excluded scope.

edgeCases.input: A caller with no Story (no base passed).
edgeCases.expected: changedFiles keeps today's working-tree derivation; no review or BUILD record path calls it that way after this fix.

invariantsToPreserve.text: A clean tree's change set is byte-for-byte today's committed-range result, including the per-unit diff for trailer units and the own-paths filter for first-parent ranges.
The only decline reason of resolveCodeReviewSubject stays 'no-build-record'; CodeReviewSubjectResult's shape is unchanged.
LEDGER_EXCLUDE_GLOBS and the caller's exclude list still apply to every diff the derivation runs.
collectBuildChangeLog never fails a build: a git failure is still swallowed to [].
Existing review records stay valid: the new excludedFromScope field is optional and absent when nothing was excluded.

migration.stateBefore: changedFiles returns the whole working-tree diff as the Story's change set whenever the tree is dirty, and reads the Story's trailered commits only on a clean tree (src/workflow/runners/build/changed-files.ts:142-178, c1). The review subject steps down from the anchored derivation to two working-tree-only derivations on a git failure (src/workflow/code-review/subject.ts:150-213, c2); the diff-only grounding reads the working tree first and, with no base, the last commit (src/workflow/code-review/grounding.ts:282-320, c3). The BUILD record writers call collectBuildChangeLog without a storyKey, and the validate gate lists typecheck projects from base..HEAD plus every uncommitted and untracked file (c4). On 2026-10-21 this reviewed six unrelated ontology files as Epic c2ba6fa6 Story s1 (ISSUE-b97752e9c7cee6fe).
migration.stateAfter: With a Story's base, changedFiles always anchors on the Story's commits (trailer units, else its first-parent own paths) and adds only working-tree edits of files in that set; every other uncommitted path is reported (excludedUncommitted) and, on a review, stamped on the subject and the record as excludedFromScope. The review subject and the diff-only grounding have no working-tree or last-commit fallback: without a base, or when git fails, they decline. The BUILD records pass the Story's storyKey, and the validate gate selects typecheck projects from the same Story set. A clean tree's results are unchanged.

migrationSteps.action: Change the shared seam's order for callers that pass a base: anchor on the Story's units, then add working-tree paths already in the set, and report the rest; add excludedUncommitted to the attribution report.
Remove the review subject's two working-tree fallbacks, carry excludedFromScope on the subject, and update its module header to the new rule.
Apply the same rule in the diff-only grounding (Story units plus own-file working-tree hunks; no working-tree-first or last-commit step) and in both diff-only callers.
Stamp excludedFromScope on the review record (optional field, absent when none).
Pass the Story's storyKey from the BUILD completion writer and the validate phase, and select the validate gate's typecheck projects from the Story's set.
Update the tests that asserted working-tree-first scoping; rebuild and update the installed daemon; re-run the observed case (a review with unrelated uncommitted files) on it.

migration.backwardCompat: No IPC payload or public signature changes: changedFiles, resolveCodeReviewSubject, assembleDiffCodeReviewGrounding and collectBuildChangeLog keep their signatures (one optional ctx field, storyKey, is added to collectBuildChangeLog). New record fields (excludedFromScope, excludedUncommitted) are optional and absent when nothing is excluded, so existing records validate. 'working-tree' stays in the ChangeSetAttribution type so older records still parse. Behaviour change by design: a review that used to judge a dirty tree now judges the Story's commits and lists the rest; a review with no resolvable base now declines.

alternativesConsidered.name: The Story's commits decide the scope; uncommitted changes join only through its own files
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Derive the Story's set from its trailer-scoped commits first; add an uncommitted change only when it touches a file in that set; report every other uncommitted path as excluded; no blind fallback.
alternativesConsidered.approach: One rule in the shared seam (changedFiles), used by every caller that knows the Story. With a base and a storyKey, the Story's set is its trailer-scoped units (storyChangeSet), exactly as today's clean-tree path computes it; the working-tree diff is then read and split: a changed path already in the Story's set is added (an in-progress edit of the Story's own file), every other path is excluded and reported through onAttribution as excludedUncommitted. The attribution says 'story-trailer' (or 'first-parent-range' when no commit carries the trailer). Without a resolvable base the Story has no committed work to anchor on: the review declines rather than reviewing the tree. The code-review subject drops its two working-tree fallbacks (a git failure on the anchored derivation declines with today's 'no-build-record'), carries excludedFromScope on the subject and the record, and its header states the new rule. The diff-only grounding applies the same rule to its hunks (Story units, plus uncommitted hunks of the Story's own files) and loses its working-tree-first and last-commit steps. The BUILD record collectors pass the storyKey so their changeLog follows the same rule.
pros: Exactly the approved fix intent: the Story's own change set is the authority and unattributable changes are reported, never judged.
Reuses what exists: storyChangeSet, the trailer, resolveStoryRangeBase, onAttribution; one rule in one seam, so the review, the diff-only path and the BUILD records cannot disagree.
An in-progress edit to a file the Story already changed is still reviewed.
cons: A Story whose work is entirely uncommitted (no trailered commit yet) has nothing to review; the tracked build commits before validate and review, so this matches the workflow, but an ad-hoc review before the first commit declines.
Changes asserted behaviour in the existing attribution tests, which must be updated.

alternativesConsidered.name: Attribute uncommitted files also by the Story's own records
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: As a1, but an uncommitted file also counts as the Story's when its PLAN tasks or BUILD record name it, so pre-commit work can be reviewed.
alternativesConsidered.approach: Everything in a1, plus a second attribution source for uncommitted paths: the files the approved PLAN's tasks or the BUILD record's changeLog name. An uncommitted path is the Story's when its commits touched it OR its records name it; everything else is excluded and reported. This lets a review run before the Story's first commit, provided its records name the files.
pros: Reviews pre-commit work that the Story's records anticipate.
Still excludes unrelated changes by default.
cons: Records name files loosely (PLAN task summaries are prose, BUILD changeLogs are themselves derived from this seam), so attribution becomes fuzzy and circular: the BUILD record's changeLog would partly attribute itself.
More machinery than the fix intent asks for; adds a flexibility nobody requested.

alternativesConsidered.name: Refuse to review a dirty tree
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Keep today's derivation, but when the working tree has any uncommitted change outside the ledger, decline the review and list the dirty paths.
alternativesConsidered.approach: The subject resolver and the diff-only path check the working tree first; any non-ledger uncommitted path makes the review decline with a new reason naming the paths. A clean tree reviews the Story's trailer-scoped range as today.
pros: Smallest change; never reviews an unrelated file.
cons: Blocks every review while anyone edits anything in the repository (the 2026-10-21 case: someone else's ontology work would stop this Story's review), which is the opposite of excluding unrelated changes from the scope.
Drops the Story's own in-progress edits instead of attributing them; the BUILD records still absorb unrelated files.
